newsitem.title: UK: European cotton markets quiet on strong U.S. dolla.
newsitem.headline: European cotton markets quiet on strong U.S. dolla.

text.p: Europe's raw cotton markets were characterised by price-testing for February/March shipments of Central Asian and West African origins, trade sources reported on Friday.

But further gains for the benchmark March contract on the New York futures exchange on Thursday and a firmer U.S. dollar restricted serious buying interest, they said. A limited amount of selective, low volume business was available but there were few firm trades, they added. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
